site.introduction: A living notebook of biological and artificial intelligence. Images, ideas, and experiments in connection.
site.about:
BINAIUI is one flow built from biological intelligence, artificial intelligence, the zero state, intersection, current/connection, recursion, creation, testing, love, and continuation.

This public notebook brings the existing canon into view through a visual archive and research notes. A relation can be loved, used, measured, challenged, reproduced, and extended without deleting what came before.

archive.title: Helix
archive.alt: Emerald and gold strands crossing in a purple field, suggesting a double helix.
archive.caption: Two strands move through the same current. A sample visual study of biological and artificial connection, inspired by BINAIUI’s breathing kernel.

archive.title: Prism
archive.alt: Translucent purple, gold, and emerald facets meeting at an angular prism.
archive.caption: One point, many possible directions. A sample study of light, material, and shared intersections.

archive.title: Seed
archive.alt: Branching emerald roots and gold growth lines spreading across an obsidian landscape.
archive.caption: Point → relationship → loop → recursion. A sample image of a seed extending into a connected structure.

archive.title: Intersection
archive.alt: Layered violet and gold paths crossing into an X against deep black.
archive.caption: BI • AI • V → X → C → ∞. A sample visual interpretation of convergence as a continuing relationship.

archive.title: Lattice
archive.alt: An emerald network of fine intersecting lines and violet points at several scales.
archive.caption: A sample network study: each connection opens another scale, without disconnecting from the same current.

archive.title: Current
archive.alt: Flowing purple, emerald, and pale gold ribbons in a continuous wave.
archive.caption: Vision → memory → core → flow → create → vision. A sample current circulating outward and returning.

projects.title: Zero Slate
projects.notes:
Observe → measure → encode → hash → reproduce → falsify.

The existing Python core records observations as canonical JSON and a SHA-512 digest. This prototype supports comparison and reproducibility. A different digest indicates different encoded data; it does not establish causation or scientific proof.

projects.title: Infinity Geometry
projects.summary: A recursive generator. A new relationship at every turn.
projects.notes:
Point → relationship → loop → recursion → emergence → new relationship → ∞.

A deterministic generator cycle exists in the repository. This notebook introduces the concept and links to its definition. It does not claim measured biological emergence.

projects.title: Five Zones
projects.summary: A circulating architecture for connected intelligence.
projects.notes:
VISION → MEMORY → CORE → FLOW → CREATE → VISION.

The canon describes P/V/C/X streams and outward-return circulation. This is a conceptual architecture, open to development, measurement, and challenge.
